Had a really great experience,  The food was awesome especially the corn and coriander sandwich, Mexican Pizza which was super fresh and full of flavor.

The staff was also very friendly and welcoming, which made the visit even better. Definitely a place I’d recommend and would love to visit again!🤩

featured_reviews.name: HARI CHOUGULE
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday, my friend and I visited Desert Junction, and it turned out to be such a great experience!
We absolutely loved the pink sauce pasta it was incredibly delicious 😋 and the sandwich was just as tasty. They have a huge variety of options.
The ambience was fantastic too, making the whole visit even more enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Dessert Junction this Sunday and had a wonderful experience. We were warmly welcomed by Mr. Ritesh, who also guided us with recommendations based on our taste preferences, which added a nice personal touch.

We began with the Sizzling Brownie with Ice Cream – the brownie was soft, rich, and paired perfectly with the ice cream, making it an indulgent treat. Following his suggestion, we tried the Trio Sundae, a delightful mix of vanilla ice cream, hot chocolate sauce, brownie chunks, and dry fruits, topped with an Oreo biscuit. It was absolutely delicious and a perfect choice for chocolate lovers.

The service was quick, and the ambience felt cozy and welcoming. They also offer a range of vegetarian snacks, making it more than just a dessert spot.

Overall, Dessert Junction is definitely a go-to place if you’re craving desserts with warm hospitality.

featured_reviews.name: shubham choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried many places pasta but this pink sauce pasta was just on spot good quality and great quantity. Great service as well. Please don't make any changes in future quality and quantity wise.

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: We tried ice-cream, thick shake, Sunday falooda,  sizzling brownie all was very good, quality was premium. Must try, service was good and also owner of store was very friendly and humble.

featured_reviews.name: Akhil Savaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered food from Desert Junction and tried their KitKat CAD and Pink Sauce Pasta — and I must say, the food was absolutely excellent!

The KitKat CAD was rich, creamy, and had the perfect balance of chocolate and crunch. The Pink Sauce Pasta was incredibly flavorful — creamy, well-seasoned, and perfectly cooked.

Great taste, good presentation, and timely service made the experience even better. Definitely ordering again. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: The IC Organic Store has an excellent collection of fresh organic products. Loved their vegan aamras (fresh mango pulp), which is sugar-free and lactose-free. featured_reviews.review_text: Just the right place to shop for the health conscious. The quality is assured and yes they are open to feedback and constantly improving.The staff are courteous and whats even better is the updates u receive regarding new products.

featured_reviews.name: Swati Tripathi
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited IC Organic Shop, and I must say it was a delightful experience! The store offers a wide range of organic products that are not only healthy but also high-quality. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable, answering all my queries and helping me find the right products. I appreciate their commitment to sustainability and eco-friendly practices, making it a great choice for conscious consumers. The shop's ambiance was calming and inviting, making my shopping experience enjoyable. I highly recommend IC Organic Shop to anyone looking for organic and eco-conscious products. I'll definitely be returning for more

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Lewis
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a regular customer, I am deeply disappointed and alarmed by my recent experience here. While eating the carrot cake, I discovered a piece of metal inside. This is not just unacceptable—it is a serious food safety hazard.

I have trusted this place for a long time, but such negligence raises grave concerns about hygiene and quality control. Food safety is non‑negotiable, and finding metal in a dessert could have caused severe harm if swallowed.

It is shocking that a café I once frequented regularly could allow such a lapse. I cannot trust this establishment again and strongly caution others to be careful.

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Bhatkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Cosy cafe with great interiors located in LIC colony. Loved the Hot Chocolate and Hazelnut Cappuccino.  The Shakshuka was great too..! Butter Croissants were nice.. Ample seating and good service. No table réservations are taken online so reach early during peak times.Great ambiance and fun vibes. Ideal for coffee date with your special one or fun with friends.!🧡

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek
featured_reviews.review_text: Used to have really good coffee, visited the place after 5-6 months, it’s lost quality. Has a new menu now which is disappointing. Ordered Mushroom risotto, which didn’t have any cheese or sauce, just boiled arborio and sautéed mushroom. The server on being asked said, this is a classic and this is how we serve it.

featured_reviews.name: Madan Singh Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
🌟 Review for CoffeeCraft 🌟

As a Matcha Frappe fan, CoffeeCraft has always been my go-to spot—but recently, I decided to try something new from their menu: the Tiramisu Iced Latte… and wow, it completely blew me away! It’s the perfect blend of rich, creamy, and just the right amount of coffee kick. Highly recommended if you’re looking to try something unique and refreshing.

I also tried one of their wraps and was genuinely impressed with the taste and freshness. Every bite was flavorful, and it paired perfectly with the drink.

A big shoutout and special thanks to the amazing team behind the experience—Karan, Akshay, Maya, and Rahul—for their warm service and great vibes. You all make the place feel welcoming and memorable.

Can’t wait to be back! ☕💚

featured_reviews.name: Hania
featured_reviews.review_text:
🍽 Food I Tried
The cheese chilli toast was honestly delicious 😋 — a generous layer of gooey, melted cheese 🧀 with just the right hit of chilli spice 🌶️. Really comforting and satisfying. The peach iced tea 🍑🫖 was refreshing but leaned towards being watered down, not very sweet, and had less ice than I would have liked.
🎶 Ambience
The place has a cozy, welcoming vibe with good background music 🎵 that adds to the experience. The staff were warm, friendly, and attentive 🤗, which really made the visit pleasant.

✨ Area of Improvement
For the peach iced tea, adding fresh mint leaves 🌿 would really lift the flavour, and it would be great if they asked customers whether they’d prefer more water or more ice. For the cheese chilli toast, offering an option of multigrain or brown bread 🍞 could be a nice touch for those who want to enjoy it without worrying too much about calories.

featured_reviews.name: Anand Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sorry to share this feedback. I have been visiting Coffee Craft for few years now. And I always had pleasant experiences to take away. Very courteous staff, lovely vibes of the place and lovely Food and Coffees. Unfortunately it was a poor experience today. I had some guests at home and thought it would be great to pick up the good coffees and desserts from Coffee Craft.

- Latte did not have the usual kick.
- Vietnamese Coffee tasted bad and not like what we get at other brand outlets.
- Biscoff coffee was way too sweet - Way beyond the usual.
- Hazelnut Frappe somehow had issues with the taste and some strange texture.
- The Burt Cheesecake and the Blueberry cheesecake were ok ok...Not much to compliment about but again it didnt taste the best.

I hope the feedback will be used in the right spirit.

Thanx.

featured_reviews.name: Lance Correia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been coming here regularly for almost a month now.... Hands down the best place to get some work done while enjoying a great cup of coffee or even a lovely date. They've got charging sockets everywhere and great wifi connection. The staff is super helpful and they brew good coffee. The mocha is a personal favourite of mine.

Special shoutout to Maya bhai for being super welcoming and helpful.

10/10 definitely recommend coming here over big name brands like starbucks or blue tokai.

Ps...they give you free cookies 😋

featured_reviews.name: JAYSHREE SASANE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I absolutely loved the Calcium & Protein Ladoos!
They are perfectly sweetened with pure jaggery, made in authentic pure ghee, and feel so light yet filling. Every bite tastes homemade, fresh, and full of goodness.
What I loved most is that they are nutritious without compromising on taste – no artificial sweetness, no heaviness, just pure nourishment. Ideal for kids, elders, and even post-workout cravings!
Finally found a sweet that truly feels like ‘health wrapped in taste’. Highly recommending for anyone looking for a guilt-free, healthy treat!

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Sasane
featured_reviews.review_text:

I can literally feel the richness of Pure Ghee and the natural sweetness of jaggery making it so comforting and wholesome. Each bite feels nourishing, energising, and perfectly balanced—not too sweet, just pure homely goodness. ✨🥰
Definitely ordering again💯and also recommending to my friends and family💯

featured_reviews.name: Urja Indulkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently came across Nagrik Dry Fruits and Ayurveda's Haldi Ladoo something I had never heard of before and surprisingly it was a wholesome experience . It felt like tasting a traditional delicacy itself . Crafted from raw turmeric root , sweetened naturally with jaggery and anchored with Gondambee . It carried a quiet wisdom of Ayurveda free from refined sugar making it more functional healing food with every bite being deeply nourishing and tasting earthy .This ladoo is a reminder of how age–old recipes seamlessly blend taste with wellness and never go out of style when honoured .

featured_reviews.name: Girlbehindthebrands
featured_reviews.review_text:
When Juices Steal the Show & Food Blows Your Mind! 🍹🍕🔥
Hidden in the heart of Borivali, Bunty’s Snacks & Juice Center is an absolute delight for anyone who loves experimenting with new flavours! 😍

Let’s start with the juices — honestly, they stole the show! From the tangy twist of Captain Juice to the vibrant, colourful Rangoli Juice, each one is refreshing and full of unique blends. The Salaar Juice packs a real punch — bold, chilled, and energizing — while Darna Mana Hai Juice is a fun, must-try surprise for brave hearts! 🥤

Moving to food, every bite is pure comfort. The Humpty Dumpty Toast is a crunchy, cheesy treat that instantly wins you over. The Festival Pizza truly lives up to its name — loaded, flavourful, and festive in every bite! 🍕 The Nachni Bhel is a healthy yet tasty twist, and the Gol Gappa Kabab is a total showstopper — chatpata, crunchy, and bursting with flavour!

And just when you think it can’t get better, the Strawberry Cream and Film City Dessert arrive to seal the deal — creamy, dreamy, and picture-perfect endings! 🍓🍨

If you’re in Borivali and haven’t been here yet, you’re missing out on a local gem. Great taste, quick service, and a vibe that makes you want to come back again and again

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Visited Bunty Juice Center – One of the Most Famous Juice & Snack Spots in Borivali

Visited Bunty Juice Center in Borivali West and had a really enjoyable experience. This place is very popular for its huge variety of juices, shakes, desserts, sandwiches, and snacks with unique presentation style.

🍹 Food & Drinks:
The menu is extremely creative with interesting names and unique serving style. Must-try items include Gabbar Mango Shake, Kiwi Strawberry Juice, Chocolate Thali, Strawberry Cream, Festival Pizza, Chowpatty Sandwich, and Jungli Sandwich. Taste was fresh, flavorful, and presentation was eye-catching.

🍨 Desserts & Presentation:
Desserts and shakes are one of the biggest highlights here. The presentation is very different and trendy, which makes it fun especially for youngsters and families.

💰 Price:
Approx ₹250–₹500 per person depending on your order. Some items feel slightly premium priced, but quantity and creativity balance it well.

🏠 Ambience:
The place has colorful interiors, vibrant atmosphere, and cozy seating. It is usually crowded in evenings and weekends because of its popularity.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is generally helpful and service is quick even during rush hours. They also guide properly if you are confused by the large menu.

🚗 Parking:
Parking can be difficult during peak time because the area gets crowded. Better to visit slightly early in evenings. They have Velvet parking facility too.

🧼 Cleanliness:
Overall cleanliness is decent considering the heavy crowd, though seating gets busy during peak hours.

📌 Overall:
Great place for juices, desserts, and innovative snacks with fun presentation. Perfect hangout spot for friends and family in Borivali.

Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.name: kajol patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bunty Cafe is a charming establishment that offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a setting that suits their preference. One of the standout features of this cafe is its popular range of juices, which are served in a visually appealing and creative way. The presentation adds an extra touch to the overall experience, making it more enjoyable.

A particular highlight was the Chaupati Sandwich, which was full of flavor and left a lasting impression. However, the pasta was a bit of a disappointment. Instead of the expected pasta sauce, it had a taste resembling a paneer gravy, which was not quite what one would expect from a pasta dish.

For dessert, the Strawberry Cream was quite delightful, offering a nice balance of sweetness and freshness. Additionally, the cafe offers a variety of funky juices, each presented with a unique setup that adds to the overall appeal. Although the juice setups are quite fancy, the juices themselves are priced higher than expected, but they remain fairly average in terms of taste.

The ambience of the cafe is simple and unassuming, but it provides a comfortable space for conversations and casual hangouts. It's a great spot for a relaxed chit-chat with friends or family, making it an ideal place to spend time with loved ones over a refreshing drink.

What truly sets this place apart is the warm and courteous staff. If you’re craving something different and delicious, this place is a must-try!
